artifact_evidence_url_ck.name: artifact_evidence_url_ck
artifact_evidence_url_ck.value:
external_url IS NULL
          OR (char_length(external_url) <= 2048 AND external_url LIKE 'https://%')

artifact_evidence_retention_ck.name: artifact_evidence_retention_ck
artifact_evidence_retention_ck.value: evidence_retained = true OR raw_payload_json IS NULL

claim_verification_run_verdict_ck.name: claim_verification_run_verdict_ck
claim_verification_run_verdict_ck.value: verdict IS NULL OR verdict IN ('verified', 'flagged_for_review', 'unverified')

claim_verification_run_window_ck.name: claim_verification_run_window_ck
claim_verification_run_window_ck.value:
(scoped_window_starts_at IS NULL) = (scoped_window_ends_at IS NULL)
          AND (scoped_window_ends_at IS NULL OR scoped_window_ends_at > scoped_window_starts_at)

compensation_payment_record_note_ck.name: compensation_payment_record_note_ck
compensation_payment_record_note_ck.value: reference_note IS NULL OR char_length(reference_note) BETWEEN 1 AND 500

compensation_period_finalize_ck.name: compensation_period_finalize_ck
compensation_period_finalize_ck.value:
(status = 'finalized' OR status = 'superseded')
            = (statement_hash IS NOT NULL)
          AND (statement_hash IS NULL)
            = (finalized_at IS NULL AND finalized_by_user_id IS NULL
               AND previous_statement_hash IS NULL AND hash_version IS NULL)
          AND (finalized_at IS NULL) = (finalized_by_user_id IS NULL)
          AND (statement_hash IS NULL OR statement_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
          AND (previous_statement_hash IS NULL
               OR previous_statement_hash = 'genesis'
               OR previous_statement_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

compensation_period_countersign_ck.name: compensation_period_countersign_ck
compensation_period_countersign_ck.value:
(countersigned_at IS NULL) = (countersigned_by_user_id IS NULL)
          AND (countersigned_at IS NULL OR finalized_at IS NOT NULL)
          AND (countersigned_by_user_id IS NULL
               OR countersigned_by_user_id IS DISTINCT FROM finalized_by_user_id)

compensation_period_supersede_ck.name: compensation_period_supersede_ck
compensation_period_supersede_ck.value:
(status = 'superseded') = (superseded_by_period_id IS NOT NULL)
          AND (superseded_by_period_id IS NULL OR superseded_by_period_id <> id)
          AND (superseded_by_period_id IS NULL) = (supersede_reason_note IS NULL)

compensation_period_line_kind_ck.name: compensation_period_line_kind_ck
compensation_period_line_kind_ck.value:
(kind = 'equity_delta')
          = (gross_amount_in_cents IS NULL AND equity_basis_points_delta IS NOT NULL)

compensation_period_line_amount_ck.name: compensation_period_line_amount_ck
compensation_period_line_amount_ck.value:
(gross_amount_in_cents IS NULL OR gross_amount_in_cents >= 0)
          AND (gross_amount_in_cents IS NULL) = (currency IS NULL)
          AND (currency IS NULL OR currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

compensation_period_line_minutes_ck.name: compensation_period_line_minutes_ck
compensation_period_line_minutes_ck.value:
(effort_minutes IS NOT NULL) = (kind = 'cash_hourly')
          AND (effort_minutes IS NULL OR effort_minutes >= 0)

compensation_period_line_equity_ck.name: compensation_period_line_equity_ck
compensation_period_line_equity_ck.value:
(equity_basis_points_delta IS NULL)
            = (equity_basis_points_at_start IS NULL AND equity_basis_points_at_end IS NULL)
          AND (equity_basis_points_at_start IS NULL
               OR equity_basis_points_at_start BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)
          AND (equity_basis_points_at_end IS NULL
               OR equity_basis_points_at_end BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)
          AND (equity_basis_points_delta IS NULL
               OR equity_basis_points_delta
                  = equity_basis_points_at_end - equity_basis_points_at_start)

daily_log_analysis_ck.name: daily_log_analysis_ck
daily_log_analysis_ck.value:
(analysis_status = 'not_requested' OR status = 'submitted')
          AND (analysis_completed_at IS NULL
               OR analysis_status IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'skipped_unconfigured'))

daily_log_ai_summary_chip_confidence_ck.name: daily_log_ai_summary_chip_confidence_ck
daily_log_ai_summary_chip_confidence_ck.value: confidence_bps IS NULL OR confidence_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 10000

daily_log_evidence_link_provenance_ck.name: daily_log_evidence_link_provenance_ck
daily_log_evidence_link_provenance_ck.value:
(source_kind = 'ai_extracted')
          = (generated_by_model IS NOT NULL AND prompt_version IS NOT NULL)

daily_log_extracted_claim_minutes_ck.name: daily_log_extracted_claim_minutes_ck
daily_log_extracted_claim_minutes_ck.value: extracted_minutes IS NULL OR extracted_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 1440

daily_log_extracted_claim_confidence_ck.name: daily_log_extracted_claim_confidence_ck
daily_log_extracted_claim_confidence_ck.value: confidence_bps IS NULL OR confidence_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 10000

daily_log_transcript_segment_offsets_ck.name: daily_log_transcript_segment_offsets_ck
daily_log_transcript_segment_offsets_ck.value:
start_offset_seconds >= 0
          AND (end_offset_seconds IS NULL OR end_offset_seconds >= start_offset_seconds)

demand_signal_snapshot_counts_ck.name: demand_signal_snapshot_counts_ck
demand_signal_snapshot_counts_ck.value:
cluster_count >= 0 AND distinct_reporter_count >= 0
          AND related_project_count >= 0 AND open_role_count >= 0
          AND (previous_demand_score_points IS NULL
               OR previous_demand_score_points BETWEEN 0 AND 100)

demand_signal_snapshot_trend_agreement_c.name: demand_signal_snapshot_trend_agreement_ck
demand_signal_snapshot_trend_agreement_c.value:
previous_demand_score_points IS NULL
          OR (trend_direction = 'up' AND demand_score_points > previous_demand_score_points)
          OR (trend_direction = 'down' AND demand_score_points < previous_demand_score_points)
          OR (trend_direction = 'flat' AND demand_score_points = previous_demand_score_points)

discovery_region_country_ck.name: discovery_region_country_ck
discovery_region_country_ck.value:
(kind = 'country') = (country_code IS NOT NULL)
          AND (country_code IS NULL OR country_code ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')

dispute_resolution_ck.name: dispute_resolution_ck
dispute_resolution_ck.value:
(status = 'consensus_reached')
          = (resolution IS NOT NULL AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND resolved_by_user_id IS NOT NULL)

dispute_window_ck.name: dispute_window_ck
dispute_window_ck.value:
(scoped_window_starts_at IS NULL) = (scoped_window_ends_at IS NULL)
          AND (scoped_window_ends_at IS NULL OR scoped_window_ends_at > scoped_window_starts_at)
          AND (scoped_window_starts_at IS NULL OR resolution = 're_verified')

effort_claim_minutes_ck.name: effort_claim_minutes_ck
effort_claim_minutes_ck.value:
(extracted_minutes IS NULL OR extracted_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 1440)
          AND (grounded_minutes IS NULL OR grounded_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 1440)
          AND (overridden_minutes IS NULL OR overridden_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 1440)

effort_claim_cash_ck.name: effort_claim_cash_ck
effort_claim_cash_ck.value:
(extracted_cash_in_cents IS NULL OR extracted_cash_in_cents >= 0)
          AND (grounded_cash_in_cents IS NULL OR grounded_cash_in_cents >= 0)

effort_claim_override_ck.name: effort_claim_override_ck
effort_claim_override_ck.value:
(overridden_minutes IS NULL) = (override_reason IS NULL)
          AND (overridden_minutes IS NULL) = (overridden_by_user_id IS NULL)
          AND (overridden_minutes IS NULL) = (overridden_at IS NULL)

escrow_release_four_eyes_ck.name: escrow_release_four_eyes_ck
escrow_release_four_eyes_ck.value: decided_by_user_id IS NULL OR decided_by_user_id <> requested_by_user_id

escrow_release_decision_ck.name: escrow_release_decision_ck
escrow_release_decision_ck.value:
(status IN ('approved','rejected'))
          = (decided_by_user_id IS NOT NULL AND decided_at IS NOT NULL
             AND verification_snapshot IS NOT NULL)

funding_round_bounds_ck.name: funding_round_bounds_ck
funding_round_bounds_ck.value:
minimum_pledge_in_cents >= 1
          AND (maximum_pledge_in_cents IS NULL
               OR maximum_pledge_in_cents >= minimum_pledge_in_cents)

funding_round_window_ck.name: funding_round_window_ck
funding_round_window_ck.value: opens_at IS NULL OR closes_at IS NULL OR closes_at > opens_at

funding_round_pledge_amounts_ck.name: funding_round_pledge_amounts_ck
funding_round_pledge_amounts_ck.value:
amount_in_cents > 0
          AND platform_fee_in_cents >= 0
          AND platform_fee_in_cents <= amount_in_cents
          AND net_to_escrow_in_cents = amount_in_cents - platform_fee_in_cents

geocode_cache_resolved_shape_ck.name: geocode_cache_resolved_shape_ck
geocode_cache_resolved_shape_ck.value:
(status = 'resolved') = (latitude_microdegrees IS NOT NULL)
          AND (latitude_microdegrees IS NULL) = (longitude_microdegrees IS NULL)
          AND (status = 'not_found' OR country_code IS NOT NULL)

geocode_cache_coordinate_range_ck.name: geocode_cache_coordinate_range_ck
geocode_cache_coordinate_range_ck.value:
(latitude_microdegrees IS NULL
           OR latitude_microdegrees BETWEEN -90000000 AND 90000000)
          AND (longitude_microdegrees IS NULL
               OR longitude_microdegrees BETWEEN -180000000 AND 180000000)

integration_consent_grant_lifecycle_ck.name: integration_consent_grant_lifecycle_ck
integration_consent_grant_lifecycle_ck.value:
(status <> 'active' OR (encrypted_access_token IS NOT NULL AND granted_at IS NOT NULL))
          AND (status <> 'revoked' OR (revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND encrypted_access_token IS NULL))
          AND (status <> 'pending' OR encrypted_access_token IS NULL)
          AND (encrypted_access_token IS NULL) = (token_key_version IS NULL)
          AND (revoked_at IS NULL) = (revoked_by_user_id IS NULL)

investor_confidence_snapshot_counts_ck.name: investor_confidence_snapshot_counts_ck
investor_confidence_snapshot_counts_ck.value:
daily_log_streak_days >= 0 AND verified_milestone_count >= 0
          AND total_milestone_count >= verified_milestone_count
          AND open_dispute_count >= 0 AND resolved_dispute_count >= 0

market_insight_stat_unit_pairing_ck.name: market_insight_stat_unit_pairing_ck
market_insight_stat_unit_pairing_ck.value:
(stat_kind IN ('percent_change','percent_level') AND stat_unit_key = 'percent')
          OR (stat_kind = 'multiplier' AND stat_unit_key = 'multiple')
          OR (stat_kind = 'absolute_count' AND stat_unit_key NOT IN ('percent','multiple'))

market_insight_stat_range_ck.name: market_insight_stat_range_ck
market_insight_stat_range_ck.value:
(stat_kind = 'percent_change' OR stat_value_milli >= 0)
          AND (stat_kind <> 'multiplier' OR stat_value_milli > 0)
          AND (stat_kind <> 'percent_level' OR stat_value_milli BETWEEN 0 AND 100000)
          AND abs(stat_value_milli) <= 9000000000000000

market_insight_trend_agreement_ck.name: market_insight_trend_agreement_ck
market_insight_trend_agreement_ck.value:
stat_kind <> 'percent_change'
          OR (trend_direction = 'up' AND stat_value_milli > 0)
          OR (trend_direction = 'down' AND stat_value_milli < 0)
          OR (trend_direction = 'flat' AND stat_value_milli = 0)

member_cash_comp_agreement_basis_ck.name: member_cash_comp_agreement_basis_ck
member_cash_comp_agreement_basis_ck.value: (monthly_amount_in_cents IS NOT NULL) <> (hourly_rate_cents_per_hour IS NOT NULL)

member_cash_comp_agreement_amount_ck.name: member_cash_comp_agreement_amount_ck
member_cash_comp_agreement_amount_ck.value:
(monthly_amount_in_cents IS NULL OR monthly_amount_in_cents >= 0)
          AND (hourly_rate_cents_per_hour IS NULL OR hourly_rate_cents_per_hour >= 0)

member_cash_comp_agreement_window_ck.name: member_cash_comp_agreement_window_ck
member_cash_comp_agreement_window_ck.value: effective_until IS NULL OR effective_until > effective_from

member_cash_comp_agreement_lifecycle_ck.name: member_cash_comp_agreement_lifecycle_ck
member_cash_comp_agreement_lifecycle_ck.value:
(status <> 'proposed' OR accepted_at IS NULL)
          AND (status <> 'withdrawn' OR accepted_at IS NULL)
          AND (status NOT IN ('active','superseded') OR accepted_at IS NOT NULL)
          AND (accepted_at IS NULL) = (accepted_by_user_id IS NULL)

member_fair_market_rate_lifecycle_ck.name: member_fair_market_rate_lifecycle_ck
member_fair_market_rate_lifecycle_ck.value:
(status <> 'proposed' OR (accepted_at IS NULL AND locked_at IS NULL))
          AND (status <> 'accepted' OR (accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND locked_at IS NULL))
          AND (status <> 'locked' OR (accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND locked_at IS NOT NULL))
          AND (accepted_at IS NULL) = (accepted_by_user_id IS NULL)
          AND (locked_at IS NULL) = (locked_by_user_id IS NULL)

milestone_variance_non_negative_ck.name: milestone_variance_non_negative_ck
milestone_variance_non_negative_ck.value:
planned_duration_days >= 0 AND actual_duration_days >= 0
          AND planned_cost_in_cents >= 0 AND actual_cost_in_cents >= 0
          AND planned_effort_minutes >= 0 AND actual_effort_minutes >= 0

open_role_compensation_kind_columns_ck.name: open_role_compensation_kind_columns_ck
open_role_compensation_kind_columns_ck.value:
(kind = 'salary' AND salary_min_in_cents_per_month IS NOT NULL
                       AND one_time_min_in_cents IS NULL AND one_time_max_in_cents IS NULL
                       AND equity_basis_points_min IS NULL AND equity_basis_points_max IS NULL)
      OR (kind = 'one_time' AND one_time_min_in_cents IS NOT NULL
                       AND salary_min_in_cents_per_month IS NULL AND salary_max_in_cents_per_month IS NULL
                       AND equity_basis_points_min IS NULL AND equity_basis_points_max IS NULL)
      OR (kind = 'equity' AND equity_basis_points_min IS NOT NULL
                       AND salary_min_in_cents_per_month IS NULL AND salary_max_in_cents_per_month IS NULL
                       AND one_time_min_in_cents IS NULL AND one_time_max_in_cents IS NULL)

open_role_compensation_policy_pairing_ck.name: open_role_compensation_policy_pairing_ck
open_role_compensation_policy_pairing_ck.value:
(kind = 'equity' AND earned_as_policy = 'slicing_pie_vesting')
      OR (kind IN ('salary','one_time')
          AND earned_as_policy IN ('off_platform_payroll','direct_transfer'))

open_role_compensation_ranges_ck.name: open_role_compensation_ranges_ck
open_role_compensation_ranges_ck.value:
(salary_min_in_cents_per_month IS NULL OR salary_min_in_cents_per_month >= 0)
      AND (salary_max_in_cents_per_month IS NULL OR salary_max_in_cents_per_month >= salary_min_in_cents_per_month)
      AND (one_time_min_in_cents IS NULL OR one_time_min_in_cents >= 0)
      AND (one_time_max_in_cents IS NULL OR one_time_max_in_cents >= one_time_min_in_cents)
      AND (equity_basis_points_min IS NULL OR equity_basis_points_min BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)
      AND (equity_basis_points_max IS NULL OR (equity_basis_points_max >= equity_basis_points_min
                                               AND equity_basis_points_max <= 10000))

optimization_suggestion_text_ck.name: optimization_suggestion_text_ck
optimization_suggestion_text_ck.value: char_length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND char_length(body_text) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000

optimization_suggestion_confidence_ck.name: optimization_suggestion_confidence_ck
optimization_suggestion_confidence_ck.value: confidence_bps IS NULL OR confidence_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 10000

optimization_suggestion_decision_ck.name: optimization_suggestion_decision_ck
optimization_suggestion_decision_ck.value:
(status = 'open') = (decided_at IS NULL)
          AND (decided_at IS NULL) = (decided_by_user_id IS NULL)

physical_work_receipt_dimensions_ck.name: physical_work_receipt_dimensions_ck
physical_work_receipt_dimensions_ck.value:
(width_pixels IS NULL OR width_pixels > 0)
          AND (height_pixels IS NULL OR height_pixels > 0)

problem_cluster_centroid_range_ck.name: problem_cluster_centroid_range_ck
problem_cluster_centroid_range_ck.value:
centroid_latitude_microdegrees BETWEEN -90000000 AND 90000000
          AND centroid_longitude_microdegrees BETWEEN -180000000 AND 180000000

problem_cluster_counts_ck.name: problem_cluster_counts_ck
problem_cluster_counts_ck.value:
distinct_reporter_count >= 0
          AND submission_count >= distinct_reporter_count
          AND submission_count >= centroid_sample_count

problem_cluster_merged_ck.name: problem_cluster_merged_ck
problem_cluster_merged_ck.value:
(status = 'merged') = (merged_into_cluster_id IS NOT NULL)
          AND (merged_into_cluster_id IS DISTINCT FROM id)

problem_cluster_score_ck.name: problem_cluster_score_ck
problem_cluster_score_ck.value:
(current_opportunity_score_points IS NULL
           OR current_opportunity_score_points BETWEEN 0 AND 100)
          AND (current_opportunity_score_points IS NULL) = (score_computed_at IS NULL)

problem_cluster_merge_proposal_decided_c.name: problem_cluster_merge_proposal_decided_ck
problem_cluster_merge_proposal_decided_c.value:
(status = 'pending') = (decided_at IS NULL)
          AND (decided_by_user_id IS NULL) = (decided_at IS NULL)

problem_cluster_score_snapshot_inputs_ck.name: problem_cluster_score_snapshot_inputs_ck
problem_cluster_score_snapshot_inputs_ck.value:
distinct_reporter_count >= 0
          AND submission_count >= distinct_reporter_count
          AND distinct_region_count >= 0
          AND category_share_basis_points BETWEEN 0 AND 10000
          AND linked_project_count >= 0

problem_cluster_score_snapshot_component.name: problem_cluster_score_snapshot_components_ck
problem_cluster_score_snapshot_component.value:
reporter_component_points >= 0 AND spread_component_points >= 0
          AND demand_component_points >= 0 AND recency_component_points >= 0
          AND scarcity_component_points >= 0
          AND reporter_component_points + spread_component_points + demand_component_points
              + recency_component_points + scarcity_component_points
              = opportunity_score_points

problem_submission_coordinate_range_ck.name: problem_submission_coordinate_range_ck
problem_submission_coordinate_range_ck.value:
(latitude_microdegrees IS NULL
           OR latitude_microdegrees BETWEEN -90000000 AND 90000000)
          AND (longitude_microdegrees IS NULL
               OR longitude_microdegrees BETWEEN -180000000 AND 180000000)
          AND (latitude_microdegrees IS NULL) = (longitude_microdegrees IS NULL)

problem_submission_cluster_shape_ck.name: problem_submission_cluster_shape_ck
problem_submission_cluster_shape_ck.value:
(status = 'clustered') = (cluster_id IS NOT NULL)
          AND (cluster_id IS NULL) = (clustered_at IS NULL)
          AND (cluster_id IS NULL OR latitude_microdegrees IS NOT NULL)

problem_submission_match_ck.name: problem_submission_match_ck
problem_submission_match_ck.value:
cluster_match_basis_points IS NULL
          OR cluster_match_basis_points BETWEEN 0 AND 10000

problem_submission_text_ck.name: problem_submission_text_ck
problem_submission_text_ck.value:
char_length(title) BETWEEN 1 AND 160
          AND char_length(description) BETWEEN 1 AND 5000
          AND char_length(location_text) BETWEEN 1 AND 200

project_application_kind_role_ck.name: project_application_kind_role_ck
project_application_kind_role_ck.value:
(kind = 'role_interest' AND open_role_id IS NOT NULL)
      OR (kind = 'join_request' AND open_role_id IS NULL)

project_audit_entry_link_ck.name: project_audit_entry_link_ck
project_audit_entry_link_ck.value:
(sequence_number = 1) = (previous_entry_hash IS NULL)
          AND (previous_entry_hash IS NULL OR previous_entry_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

project_audit_entry_labels_ck.name: project_audit_entry_labels_ck
project_audit_entry_labels_ck.value:
char_length(action_label) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
          AND char_length(target_label) BETWEEN 1 AND 200
          AND char_length(detail_note) <= 2000

project_chain_head_sequence_ck.name: project_chain_head_sequence_ck
project_chain_head_sequence_ck.value:
last_audit_sequence_number >= 0 AND last_ledger_sequence_number >= 0
          AND last_escrow_sequence_number >= 0
          AND last_compensation_sequence_number >= 0

project_chain_head_hash_ck.name: project_chain_head_hash_ck
project_chain_head_hash_ck.value:
(head_entry_hash IS NULL OR head_entry_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
          AND (last_anchored_hash IS NULL OR last_anchored_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
          AND (escrow_head_entry_hash IS NULL OR escrow_head_entry_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
          AND (last_audit_sequence_number = 0) = (head_entry_hash IS NULL)
          AND (last_escrow_sequence_number = 0) = (escrow_head_entry_hash IS NULL)

project_chain_head_compensation_hash_ck.name: project_chain_head_compensation_hash_ck
project_chain_head_compensation_hash_ck.value:
(compensation_head_statement_hash IS NULL
           OR compensation_head_statement_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
          AND (compensation_head_statement_hash IS NULL) = (compensation_head_period_id IS NULL)

project_invite_live_role_unq.name: project_invite_live_role_unq
project_invite_live_role_unq.where: status = 'pending' AND open_role_id IS NOT NULL

project_member_left_after_joined_ck.name: project_member_left_after_joined_ck
project_member_left_after_joined_ck.value: left_at IS NULL OR left_at >= joined_at

project_member_interval_order_ck.name: project_member_interval_order_ck
project_member_interval_order_ck.value: left_at IS NULL OR left_at > joined_at

project_member_interval_ended_ck.name: project_member_interval_ended_ck
project_member_interval_ended_ck.value:
(left_at IS NULL) = (ended_reason IS NULL)
          AND (ended_by_user_id IS NULL OR ended_reason = 'removed')

project_open_role_slots_ck.name: project_open_role_slots_ck
project_open_role_slots_ck.value: slots_total BETWEEN 1 AND 50 AND slots_filled_count BETWEEN 0 AND slots_total

project_stats_counters_non_negative_ck.name: project_stats_counters_non_negative_ck
project_stats_counters_non_negative_ck.value:
watchers_count >= 0 AND team_member_count >= 0
          AND open_role_count >= 0 AND pending_application_count >= 0

project_stats_allocated_equity_ck.name: project_stats_allocated_equity_ck
project_stats_allocated_equity_ck.value:
allocated_equity_basis_points IS NULL
          OR (allocated_equity_basis_points BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)

provider_transfer_failed_at_ck.name: provider_transfer_failed_at_ck
provider_transfer_failed_at_ck.value:
(status = 'failed') = (failed_at IS NOT NULL)
          AND (status = 'failed') = (failure_reason IS NOT NULL)

receipt_forensics_check_confidence_ck.name: receipt_forensics_check_confidence_ck
receipt_forensics_check_confidence_ck.value: confidence_bps IS NULL OR confidence_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 10000

research_project_offered_equity_ck.name: research_project_offered_equity_ck
research_project_offered_equity_ck.value:
(offered_equity_basis_points_min IS NULL OR (offered_equity_basis_points_min BETWEEN 0 AND 10000))
          AND (offered_equity_basis_points_max IS NULL OR (offered_equity_basis_points_max BETWEEN 0 AND 10000))
          AND (offered_equity_basis_points_min IS NULL OR offered_equity_basis_points_max IS NULL
               OR offered_equity_basis_points_min <= offered_equity_basis_points_max)

proposal_locked_shape.name: proposal_locked_shape
proposal_locked_shape.value: (status <> 'locked') OR (locked_at IS NOT NULL AND settled_ledger_entry_id IS NOT NULL)

proposal_consensus_shape.name: proposal_consensus_shape
proposal_consensus_shape.value:
(status <> 'consensus_reached')
          OR (consensus_reached_at IS NOT NULL AND settled_ledger_entry_id IS NOT NULL)

proposal_disputed_shape.name: proposal_disputed_shape
proposal_disputed_shape.value:
(status <> 'disputed')
          OR (active_dispute_id IS NOT NULL AND escrowed_slices = proposed_slices)

proposal_slices_ck.name: proposal_slices_ck
proposal_slices_ck.value:
proposed_slices >= 0 AND escrowed_slices >= 0 AND proposed_slice_numerator >= 0
          AND proposed_time_slice_numerator >= 0 AND proposed_cash_slice_numerator >= 0
          AND proposed_slice_numerator
              = proposed_time_slice_numerator + proposed_cash_slice_numerator

slice_ledger_entry_sign_ck.name: slice_ledger_entry_sign_ck
slice_ledger_entry_sign_ck.value:
(entry_kind = 'award' AND slices_awarded >= 0 AND slice_numerator >= 0)
          OR (entry_kind = 'reversal' AND slices_awarded <= 0 AND slice_numerator <= 0)

slice_ledger_entry_inputs_ck.name: slice_ledger_entry_inputs_ck
slice_ledger_entry_inputs_ck.value:
(contribution_kind = 'time')
            = (effort_minutes IS NOT NULL AND unpaid_rate_cents_per_hour IS NOT NULL)
          AND (contribution_kind = 'cash') = (cash_in_cents IS NOT NULL)

supplier_quantities_ck.name: supplier_quantities_ck
supplier_quantities_ck.value:
(lead_time_days IS NULL OR lead_time_days BETWEEN 0 AND 3650)
          AND (minimum_order_quantity IS NULL OR minimum_order_quantity >= 0)

supplier_contact_ck.name: supplier_contact_ck
supplier_contact_ck.value: contact_policy <> 'direct_email' OR website_url IS NOT NULL

talent_compensation_ask_kind_columns_ck.name: talent_compensation_ask_kind_columns_ck
talent_compensation_ask_kind_columns_ck.value:
(kind = 'salary' AND salary_min_in_cents_per_month IS NOT NULL
                       AND one_time_min_in_cents IS NULL AND one_time_max_in_cents IS NULL
                       AND equity_basis_points_min IS NULL AND equity_basis_points_max IS NULL)
      OR (kind = 'one_time' AND one_time_min_in_cents IS NOT NULL
                       AND salary_min_in_cents_per_month IS NULL AND salary_max_in_cents_per_month IS NULL
                       AND equity_basis_points_min IS NULL AND equity_basis_points_max IS NULL)
      OR (kind = 'equity' AND equity_basis_points_min IS NOT NULL
                       AND salary_min_in_cents_per_month IS NULL AND salary_max_in_cents_per_month IS NULL
                       AND one_time_min_in_cents IS NULL AND one_time_max_in_cents IS NULL)

talent_compensation_ask_ranges_ck.name: talent_compensation_ask_ranges_ck
talent_compensation_ask_ranges_ck.value:
(salary_min_in_cents_per_month IS NULL OR salary_min_in_cents_per_month >= 0)
      AND (salary_max_in_cents_per_month IS NULL OR salary_max_in_cents_per_month >= salary_min_in_cents_per_month)
      AND (one_time_min_in_cents IS NULL OR one_time_min_in_cents >= 0)
      AND (one_time_max_in_cents IS NULL OR one_time_max_in_cents >= one_time_min_in_cents)
      AND (equity_basis_points_min IS NULL OR equity_basis_points_min BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)
      AND (equity_basis_points_max IS NULL OR (equity_basis_points_max >= equity_basis_points_min
                                               AND equity_basis_points_max <= 10000))

talent_profile_cached_ck.name: talent_profile_cached_ck
talent_profile_cached_ck.value:
(cached_effort_minutes_logged IS NULL OR cached_effort_minutes_logged >= 0)
          AND (cached_projects_completed_count IS NULL OR cached_projects_completed_count >= 0)
          AND (cached_effort_minutes_logged IS NULL) = (projection_computed_at IS NULL)

talent_profile_skill_verified_ck.name: talent_profile_skill_verified_ck
talent_profile_skill_verified_ck.value:
(is_verified = false) = (verified_at IS NULL)
          AND (verified_effort_minutes IS NULL OR verified_effort_minutes >= 0)

verification_step_score_ck.name: verification_step_score_ck
verification_step_score_ck.value:
(score_bps IS NULL OR score_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)
          AND (confidence_bps IS NULL OR confidence_bps BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)

verification_step_override_ck.name: verification_step_override_ck
verification_step_override_ck.value:
(overridden_status IS NULL) = (reviewed_by_user_id IS NULL)
          AND (overridden_status IS NULL) = (override_reason IS NULL)
          AND (overridden_status IS NULL) = (reviewed_at IS NULL)
          AND (overridden_status IS NULL OR overridden_status <> 'pending')

workshop_chat_message_edited_ck.name: workshop_chat_message_edited_ck
workshop_chat_message_edited_ck.value: edited_at IS NULL OR edited_at >= sent_at

workshop_file_source_shape_ck.name: workshop_file_source_shape_ck
workshop_file_source_shape_ck.value:
(source = 'external_link'
             AND external_url IS NOT NULL AND external_host IS NOT NULL
             AND size_bytes IS NULL AND object_key IS NULL)
          OR (source = 'hosted' AND object_key IS NOT NULL)

workshop_file_externalUrl_ck.name: workshop_file_externalUrl_ck
workshop_file_externalUrl_ck.value:
external_url IS NULL
          OR (char_length(external_url) <= 2048 AND external_url LIKE 'https://%')

workshop_file_removed_ck.name: workshop_file_removed_ck
workshop_file_removed_ck.value: (removed_by_user_id IS NULL) OR (removed_at IS NOT NULL)
